description: UCL Student Union Activity Registration Form (ARF). SCAFFOLD: every field below is drafted from the SU's public guidance and has an unconfirmed selector (confirmed: false), so a fill finds little or nothing until a signed-in capture confirms them. The president or treasurer must submit one at least 10 working days ahead, and earlier for bigger activity (8 weeks for tours, trips abroad and large campus events; 6 for balls and large off-campus events; 4 for spectator sport, controversial speakers and catered events; 2 for socials and workshops), when the activity spends over £350, raises money for charity, is high-risk, is run with an external organisation, UCL department or non-affiliated group, staff have asked for one, or it isn't regularly-held activity. Nothing else for the activity is approved, and it can't be promoted, until the ARF is. It records a budget: expenditure lines and income lines (how each cost is covered), which must make a profit or break even and include a 15% contingency; ticket income is a breakdown of price x projected sales, never more than 50% of capacity. A payment request can link to a submission of this form.

fields.name: club_society
fields.description: Club or Society Name (type to search, Enter to select). The payment and purchase forms share this element; assumed here too.

fields.name: activity_name
fields.description: Name of the activity or event

fields.name: activity_description
fields.description: What the activity is and what will happen

fields.name: reason_expenditure_over_350
fields.description: Registration criterion: the activity's expenditure is over £350

fields.name: reason_charity
fields.description: Registration criterion: raising money for a charity (tickets then need an approved Charity Permission Letter)

fields.name: reason_high_risk
fields.description: Registration criterion: high-risk activity (overnight stays, trips outside London or abroad, contact sport, naked flames, 100+ attendees, alcohol, controversial speakers, under-18s, the public, external catering, power tools, sharp implements, live animals). Also needs an Additional Risk Assessment.

fields.name: reason_external_collaboration
fields.description: Registration criterion: collaborating with an external organisation, UCL department or other non-affiliated group

fields.name: reason_staff_request
fields.description: Registration criterion: Union staff asked for this form

fields.name: reason_not_regular
fields.description: Registration criterion: not regularly-held activity covered by the core risk assessment (annual events count as not regular)

fields.name: start_date
fields.description: First day of the activity, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/London)

fields.name: start_time
fields.description: Start time, HH:MM (Europe/London)

fields.name: end_date
fields.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD; the start date for a one-evening event (a run of performances is several dates, not one long span)

fields.name: end_time
fields.description: Finish time, HH:MM (Europe/London)

fields.name: location
fields.description: Where it happens: room or venue name and address

fields.name: expected_attendance
fields.description: How many people are expected

fields.name: overnight_or_abroad
fields.description: Does the activity involve an overnight stay or travel abroad? (8 weeks' notice abroad; the Additional Risk Assessment's overnight section then needs an itinerary, travel and participant details)

fields.name: external_speaker
fields.description: Is there an external speaker? (needs an approved External Speaker Request Form, 10 working days)

fields.name: expenditure
fields.description: Budget: what will be spent, one line per cost, including a 15% contingency line

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the cost is (venue hire, DJ, decorations, food, printing, contingency)

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Cost in GBP, e.g. 50.00

fields.name: income
fields.description: Budget: how each cost is covered, one line per source: grant or non-grant account contribution, sponsorship, ticket sales broken down by price ('Early Bird Ticket - £10 x 15 = £150.00', never budgeting over 50% sales), membership contributions, bar or food sales, merchandise. Income minus expenditure must be zero or more.
